reason: Both satisfy every hard requirement, but B places the snapshot unambiguously as the very first IMMEDIATE ACTION (deferring even job-pausing until after confirmation), whereas A pauses jobs before the snapshot step, muddying the snapshot-first sequencing; B also gives a more concrete, testable abort condition (explicit 5-minute failover threshold) and adds a post-incident data-integrity check (row count/checksum comparison against the snapshot) that A omits.
